name: Countdown
description: A live countdown to a moment, shown as days, hours, minutes and seconds. It ticks every second and shows a finished message when the time has passed.
whenToUse: To count down to a launch, a deadline or the end of a sale.
On a page where the date is the main message.

whenNotToUse.text: To show how long something took.
For a short timeout in a form.

anatomy.name: Units
anatomy.description: Days, hours, minutes and seconds, each a number over its name.

anatomy.name: Ended message
anatomy.description: Shown instead of the units once the time has passed.

values.meaning: Inside a card or a banner.
The main message of a launch page.

states.name: Ended
states.meaning: The time has passed; the ended message shows.

behavior.text: The countdown updates every second using the live clock, unless a fixed now is given.
The countdown is read as one sentence, not every second, so screen readers are not flooded.
Units are laid out from the start in Arabic; numbers stay in Western digits unless you set them.

content: Name what is counted, e.g. "Launch in".
Give the units in the language of the page through the units prop.

guidelines.do: Show the date as well as the countdown.
guidelines.dont: Show only a countdown with no date.
guidelines.why: The date lets people plan and confirms what the countdown means.

guidelines.do: Replace the countdown with a clear message when it ends.
guidelines.dont: Leave a counter stuck at zero.
guidelines.why: A finished message tells people the moment has passed.

guidelines.dont: Stack several countdowns to different dates.
guidelines.why: Several moving numbers compete for attention.

accessibility.role: section named with the full sentence, e.g. "Launch in 12 days, 8 hours, 45 minutes, 20 seconds".

keyboard.action: No keyboard interaction; use the controls inside, if any.

aria.when: On the section: the whole countdown as one sentence.

wcag.how: Units are a list with their names beside the numbers.
The countdown is informational and does not end content or require a response.

notes: The visible units are hidden from assistive technology; the section label reads them once.

examples.title: Launch
examples.description: A large countdown on a launch page.
examples.code:
import { Countdown } from '@ds/react';

<Countdown label="Launch in" to={new Date('2026-11-01T09:00:00Z')} size="large" />

examples.title: In a card
examples.description: A small countdown inside a promotion card.
examples.code:
import { Countdown } from '@ds/react';

<Countdown label="Sale ends in" to={saleEnds} size="small" endedLabel="Sale over" />

examples.title: Translated
examples.code:
import { Countdown } from '@ds/react';

<Countdown label="يبدأ خلال" to={launch} units={{ days: 'يوم', hours: 'ساعة', minutes: 'دقيقة', seconds: 'ثانية' }} />

related.relation: For an event that has happened.

components.name: Countdown
components.description:
A live countdown to a moment, shown as days, hours, minutes and seconds. It ticks every second
unless a fixed `now` is given.

label.description: Names what is counted down to, e.g. "Launch in". Read before the time.

to.description: The moment to count down to.

now.description: The current time, for tests and static previews. Default: the live clock.

units.type: { days: string; hours: string; minutes: string; seconds: string; }
units.description: Words for the units. Default English.

endedLabel.description: Words shown when the time has passed. Default "Done".

size.description: `small` in cards, `medium` (default), `large` for a launch page.

--countdown-label-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--countdown-ended-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.
